HEIC still-photo conversion in SuarezCFI uses libheif-js 1.23.5,
libheif, and libde265. Conversion runs locally in a cancellable worker.
The library bundle is unmodified and loaded separately from the application.

Copyright and licenses:
  libheif-js: Kiril Vatev; GNU LGPL version 3.
  libheif: Dirk Farin and contributors; GNU LGPL version 3.
  libde265: Dirk Farin and contributors; GNU LGPL version 3.
  Full notices are retained in LICENSE, LICENSE-libheif-js,
  LICENSE-libde265 and the source archives, including MIT-licensed components.

Source and build records are available beside this notice:
  README.md
  sources/manifest.json
  sources/libheif-js-d8ec4bc.tar.gz
  sources/libheif-emscripten-v1.23.5.tar.gz
  sources/libheif-413e2a8.tar.gz
  sources/libde265-1.0.15.tar.gz

Upstream:
  https://github.com/catdad-experiments/libheif-js
  https://github.com/catdad-experiments/libheif-emscripten
  https://github.com/strukturag/libheif
  https://github.com/strukturag/libde265

The separate library can be rebuilt or replaced using these sources.
SuarezCFI imposes no restriction on modifying or debugging this library.
Application integration source is in ../../js/photo-intake.js and
../../js/heif-worker.js and https://github.com/IXSUAREZ/ixsuarez.github.io.
